description: Set up environment, create seed data, storage layer, constants, and AppContext integration for the Document Management module
steps: Run `npm install` to confirm the project builds from the current state
Run `npm run build` to confirm baseline is green

Create src/data/seedDocuments.js with seed data for nurse documents (per-nurse document records with types: passport, nursing qualification, OET certificate, IELTS, CBT certificate, NMC decision letter, visa documents, references), document statuses (pending, verified, expired, rejected), expiry dates, verification history, and document templates (offer letters, reference request forms, compliance certificates). Also include a verification queue with pending review items. Use the same seededRandom pattern from seedPlacements.js. Link documents to existing nurse IDs (nurse-001 through nurse-067). Generate 5-8 documents per nurse for nurses in later pipeline stages, fewer for early stages. Include document templates with id, name, type, content placeholder text, and category.

Add document-related constants to src/lib/constants.js: DOCUMENT_TYPES array (Passport, Nursing Qualification, OET Certificate, IELTS Certificate, CBT Certificate, NMC Decision Letter, Visa Documents, References), DOCUMENT_STATUSES array (Pending, Verified, Expired, Rejected), DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE_TYPES array (Offer Letter, Reference Request Form, Compliance Certificate), VERIFICATION_ACTIONS array (Approved, Rejected), and COMPLIANCE_REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS object mapping pipeline stages to arrays of required document type strings

Add storage functions to src/lib/storage.js: import seedDocuments from data file, add getDocuments/saveDocuments, getDocumentTemplates/saveDocumentTemplates, getVerificationQueue/saveVerificationQueue functions following existing pattern. Add initialization block in initializeData() for documents, documentTemplates, and verificationQueue

Add state to src/context/AppContext.jsx: import getDocuments/saveDocuments, getDocumentTemplates/saveDocumentTemplates, getVerificationQueue/saveVerificationQueue. Add useState + useCallback updateDocuments, updateDocumentTemplates, updateVerificationQueue. Add all to context value object.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with no errors
src/data/seedDocuments.js exports seedDocuments() returning an object with { documents: [...], templates: [...], verificationQueue: [...] }
src/lib/constants.js exports DOCUMENT_TYPES, DOCUMENT_STATUSES, DOCUMENT_TEMPLATE_TYPES, VERIFICATION_ACTIONS, and COMPLIANCE_REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS
src/lib/storage.js has get/save functions for documents, documentTemplates, verificationQueue and initializes them in initializeData()
src/context/AppContext.jsx exposes documents, documentTemplates, verificationQueue state and their update functions
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm zero errors
Run `npm run lint` and confirm no critical issues
findings: Build passes cleanly. Two pre-existing lint errors in AppContext.jsx (unused useEffect import and react-refresh/only-export-components) are not introduced by this change. The seedDocuments function generates 1-3 docs for early-stage nurses, 3-5 for mid-stage, and 5-8 for late-stage nurses per the acceptance criteria. All constants, storage functions, and context integration follow existing patterns exactly.
